areas.document: Open, select and close project tabs; audio engine state.
areas.project: Whole-project reads and edits: dump, time ranges, metadata, files, rendering.
areas.transport: Tempo, position, loop, playback, groove and time signature.
areas.track: Main and group tracks: create, delete, read, mixer and routing.
areas.device: Devices on any chain: insert, parameters, plugins, nested chains, Grid, layers, samplers, modulators.
areas.automation: Arranger automation lanes and automation clips.
areas.clip: Arranger clips: create, read, copy, split, edit, notes, audio import.
areas.note: Single MIDI notes inside a clip or launcher slot.
areas.audio_event: Single audio events inside an audio clip.
areas.launcher: Clip launcher slots: author, launch, stop, settings.
areas.debug: Diagnostics for reverse engineering; not for normal use.
